info.name: This API gives the Summary balance i.e., shared balances and personal balances of the customer from IBF. It also returns the XtraTime usage and lonable amount details.

params.name: transactionId
params.description: Transaction ID for the command being executed.

params.name: sourceIdentifier
params.description: Channel name of the source system.

params.name: balanceType
params.description: Indicates the summary balance type that is required.  By default all is returned for all non prepaid subscribers and for prepaid subscribers usage limit will not be returned. The service will be enhanced in future to return the YB and MoMo balances as well. The filter can currently be set to one of the following: "ALL", "Airtime", "Data","Voice","SMS","Usage Limit", "Xtratime"
